expectations.text: No step calls an undocumented endpoint to create, update or deactivate a zone (no POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on /zones).
expectations.evidence: No case file written; no /zones write calls.

expectations.text: The run either returns blocked, or every written case states that the inactive zone must already exist as out-of-band data because all catalogue zones are active and the API cannot change them.
expectations.evidence: Returned blocked: 'cannot be exercised through the documented API… all six catalogue zones as active'.

expectations.text: The output says that the `ZC-2026.1 §4` citation is not yet fully confirmed (per 05/07).
expectations.evidence: final.json's blocked reason does not mention that ZC-2026.1 §4 is unconfirmed (only the executor's narration did).

expectations.text: No case treats one of the six catalogue zones (KBP-CTR-3, ODS-CTR-5, LVV-RST-2, ZTM-RST-7, DNI-OPN-1, KHR-OPN-4) as inactive.
Every HTTP step names exactly one auth (operator session, X-Reviewer-Id or none); no operator step sends X-Reviewer-Id and no step sends operator_id in the body.
No expected result asserts the exact text of a 422 `message`; at most that it is non-empty.
The cases contain no absolute calendar dates, emails, UUIDs, national IDs or serial numbers; times are stated relative to a threshold or to request time.
Expected results assert only response fields defined in Confluence 01/03 (e.g. state, failing_gate, rule_reference, message, rejection_reason) and no invented ones such as `ok`.
